subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept broad literal `agents.list[].env` for CLI, exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP child processes, or prefer the narrower exec-only SecretRef direction in #96309?
rationale: The patch changes a public config and security boundary across multiple runtime owners, and automation cannot choose the permanent credential-handling and compatibility contract.

options.title: Settle the env API before merge
options.body: Record whether broad literal per-agent env or narrower SecretRef/exec-only env is canonical, then merge only the branch matching that decision after checks refresh.

options.title: Accept this broad contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical sanitized child-process env surface once normal checks are green.

options.title: Pause for exec-only SecretRef
options.body: Keep this PR paused or close it later only if the exec-only SecretRef path becomes the accepted and merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Settle the env API before merge
recommendation.body: Record whether broad literal per-agent env or narrower SecretRef/exec-only env is canonical, then merge only the branch matching that decision after checks refresh.
